gate: ADAPT if: >=0.003 held-out NFL log-loss improvement on 2025 games versus the raw-features baseline, <=30 generated features, all groupby/external features AST- and timestamp-verified causal, total pipeline runtime under 60 minutes; REJECT if any of: no gate improvement, feature count exceeds the efficiency budget without proportional gain, external-source timestamps fail the pre-prediction check, or CAAFE beats it on the sports panel.

title: ContTune: Continuous Tuning by Conservative Bayesian Optimization for Distributed Stream Data Processing Systems
improvement: Apply the pattern to GSE's batch compute: (1) weekly feature-build tuning - stage skew (max/med task duration), spill, idle executor time as controller analog; Big-small skeleton: Big phase = binary-lift partitions on skewed stages until skew < 2x; Small phase = GP over <parallelism, stage-throughput> observations reused across weeks, with the feasibility indicator guarding the build SLA (must finish before the weekly serving window); (2) engine hyperparameter search under serving SLA - CBO template with conservative exploration near unknown regions so no sweep violates the p99 <= 50 ms serving gate; Top-K + mean-reversion noise treatment for noisy build metrics; keep <=2 parameter changes per week - plus grid-search alpha (the paper's untuned known-region radius) in {0,1,2,3,5} on build historical logs via replay simulation.
gate: ADOPT the tuning controller iff: (a) >= 25% reduction in total build compute cost (executor-hours) OR >= 25% reduction in build wall-clock vs the 4-week baseline; (b) zero build-SLA violations during the 2-week history-reuse period; (c) GP-guided suggestions never exceed 2 parameter changes per week; REJECT if the GP's suggestions are no better than the binary-lift heuristic alone.

title: Counterfactual Conservative Q Learning for Offline Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning
improvement: Model each slate position i as an agent: action a^i in {0, 0.25u, 0.5u, 1u, 2u}; shared reward = weekly portfolio profit; global state = slate context + running exposure; train CFCQL: joint Q-network over (state, stake vector) with the counterfactual penalty (Eq 4) - penalize agent i's stake deviations holding other bets' stakes at historical values, lambda_i proportional to 1/(number of bets) or Kelly weight; decentralized execution: per-bet stake policy pi^i(a^i | slate features, exposure so far) applied sequentially through the slate with the exposure cap as a hard constraint; keep scalar CQL as the single-bet baseline - with learned lambda_i: weight each bet's counterfactual penalty by its historical edge variance (high-variance bets get more conservatism).
gate: ADOPT iff on 2024 CFCQL beats independent-CQL ROI by >=1pp with max drawdown no worse AND the lower-bound diagnostic holds on >=90% of weeks; if MACQL is not actually over-conservative in this domain (gap < 1pp), REJECT the multi-agent machinery as unnecessary complexity.

title: Early Churn Prediction from Large Scale User-Product Interaction Time Series
improvement: Build audience churn prediction from first-party engagement events: per-user daily aggregates over trailing 30 days (site pageviews, newsletter opens/clicks, X engagement with @GalaxySportsHQ, Kit-page visits); GBT baseline (LightGBM) on mu/sigma aggregates; Transformer encoder (~1-2M params) on the 30-day sequences with 4 sigmoid heads for weeks 1-4; time-ordered split (train months 1-9, validate month 10, test months 11-12), weekly batch scoring feeding the retention playbook (win-back content, promo targeting) - plus exogenous event features the paper excluded: NFL schedule intensity (primetime games, bye weeks), GSE content calendar, promo drops as additional input channels to the Transformer.
gate: ADAPT if: the Transformer encoder beats the GBT baseline by >= 0.03 AUC on at least 3 of the 4 weeks on the time-ordered test window; reject otherwise (keep the cheaper GBT).

title: Evaluating Soccer Match Prediction Models: A Deep Learning Approach and Feature Optimization for Gradient-Boosted Trees
improvement: Install the baselines-board discipline: for every GSE prediction surface (NFL spread, total, moneyline; props later), maintain a living leaderboard of pi-ratings (implement on nflverse scores back to 2006), de-vigged consensus odds, and historical outcome frequencies - no model ships unless it beats all three out-of-sample; adopt the challenge protocol internally: freeze a full-season blind hold-out (272 regular-season + postseason games) scored by a locked script, reporting RMSE (margins) and RPS-style metrics on the ordinal cover result (cover/push/not) - plus the exact paper comparison on NFL data: XGBoost over ~100 engineered features vs the same features plus pi-rating deltas vs a Transformer-over-recent-games architecture, all trained strictly chronologically on the blind season hold-out.
gate: ADOPT the baselines-board discipline if the pi-ratings baseline reproduces its soccer-paper behavior on NFL (beats or matches our current engine's simple variants on 2024-2025 hold-out); ADAPT as above regardless. Any new complex model is REJECTED unless it beats pi-ratings AND de-vigged consensus by >=0.003 Brier and >=0.005 log-loss on both hold-out seasons - the margin below which this paper shows noise dominates.

title: A generative approach to frame-level multi-competitor races
improvement: As engine-honesty infrastructure, build a GSE 'game simulator' in the paper's image: concrete first build = in-play NFL win-probability surface from nflverse play-by-play + NGS tracking - fit a generative drive-outcome model conditioned on field position, time, score, and personnel; forward-simulate 10k rest-of-game paths per live game state from any game state; publish the WP surface with uncertainty bands as an independent cross-check of the production live WP model; run counterfactual experiments ('what if the blitz had come from the other side') for model diagnostics - plus an odds-aware variant: calibrate the simulator's outputs against Pinnacle closing lines (Platt scaling per game-state bucket), testing whether miscalibration residuals predict line moves.
gate: ADAPT confirmed if the nflverse-level rest-of-game simulator's win probabilities achieve Brier score <= the published nflfastR WP model's Brier on the 2024 season (paired by game), AND the simulator's 80% WP intervals cover realized outcomes at 78-82%; if it cannot match the discriminative baseline, the counterfactual machinery still stands for diagnostics use.

title: Sparse Identification of Nonlinear Dynamics with Side Information (SINDy-SI)
improvement: Discover GSE's 'laws of the game' equations: reimplement SINDy-SI (cvxpy + SCS/Clarabel or MOSEK, monomial library, SOS constraints via Putinar helper) and encode sports side information: boundedness (win-prob dynamics in [0,1]), equilibrium (tied game at t=0 => drift zero), monotonicity (d(win-prob)/d(score_diff) >= 0, d/d(opponent_timeouts) <= 0), time-decay momentum symmetry; discover dynamics on 2022-2024 nflverse game-state trajectories with constraints active, threshold lambda tuned by leave-one-season-out CV; ship the constrained equation as a guaranteed-sane dynamics model that can veto engine outputs violating the encoded side information - plus data-driven side-information mining: fit an unconstrained SINDy ensemble across 2015-2024, promote only the 10/10-season-stable qualitative properties to SOS hard constraints, and re-fit (a self-bootstrapping discover->constrain->re-discover loop).
gate: ADOPT if: SINDy-SI beats unconstrained SINDy on J_k by >= 1 order of magnitude on the leave-one-season-out CV AND the learned model satisfies all encoded side information exactly (verified by SOS certificate, not sampling) AND BFR >= 60% on open-loop 2025 holdout; REJECT if: SDP solve time exceeds 30 min per fit at n=6/degree-4, or constraints reduce fit quality below the unconstrained baseline by > 20%, or J_k gap < 1 order of magnitude.

title: Lag-Llama: Towards Foundation Models for Probabilistic Time Series Forecasting
improvement: Implement the lag-covariate constructor for weekly sports: lags {1,2,3,4,8,16} games for margins/totals/usage, plus sports-native covariates (rest-day differential, travel distance, dome/outdoor, opponent rolling EPA, line movement) replacing date-time features; decoder-only transformer ~2-10M params, Student-t head; pretrain on the sports pile from ledger 2124, fine-tune per season/task; distributions feed the same pricing layer as Chronos paths - plus a sports-native covariate swap study: (a) paper's lags + date-time vs (b) sports lags + rest/travel/weather/opponent covariates vs (c) (b) + market line as a covariate, measuring CRPS deltas; the (b)-(c) residual gap directly quantifies GSE's forecasting alpha over the line.
gate: ADOPT the lag-covariate recipe if the sports Lag-Llama variant's CRPS beats seasonal naive by >=8% on 2021-2024 AND its 80% prediction intervals are calibrated within +/-4 pts; ADAPT further (head/covariate upgrades) if it beats naive but misses calibration; REJECT the frozen/zero-shot variant for any live use; hard reject if interval coverage deviates >8 pts.

title: The Data Lakehouse: Data Warehousing and More
improvement: Adopt the lakehouse pattern for GSE's analytical/offline layer at small scale: cloud object storage + Delta Lake for bronze (raw nflverse pulls, odds snapshots, NGS dumps), silver (cleaned play-by-play), gold (feature tables); table format over file format (every read gets time travel + schema evolution); data-as-code branching in lightweight form - weekly feature-table builds land on a staging branch, the backtest suite runs against the branch, atomic promotion to prod only on pass (directly implementing the acceptance gates in ledgers 2022/2024); DuckDB/Spark for batch builds reading the same Delta tables as training (zero export ETL); SCD type 2 for team/coach/roster dimensions via Delta time travel - plus lakehouse-native feature lineage: embed the feature-DSL fingerprint and source Delta versions as table properties on every gold feature table, making each feature table self-describing.
gate: ADOPT the lakehouse layout iff: (i) time-travel reproduction is byte-identical on the 2024 replay, (ii) the branch gate catches the injected corruption (no prod contamination), (iii) exactly one physical copy of each raw dataset exists; REJECT the branching discipline (keep single-table writes) if branch-merge overhead adds >10% to the weekly build time.

title: TabSyn: Score-based Tabular Diffusion in VAE Latent Space
improvement: Build TabSyn as the recommended primary synthetic-season backbone: nflverse team-game table 2015-2025 (~30 columns, mixed types), quantile-transform skewed numerics; column tokenizer (d=4 embeddings per column, incl. team/opponent IDs - no one-hot), 2-layer Transformer encoder/decoder VAE with adaptive beta schedule; VE-SDE diffusion on flattened latent, 5-layer SiLU denoising MLP, sampling with <=20 NFEs; regime label embeddings for conditional sampling (required for rare-regime oversampling); generate 3-5 synthetic seasons, downstream GBDT spread model trained real+synthetic - plus conditional latent diffusion with learned regime prompts: a learned 'regime prompt' vector (team-tier x outcome-class x weather-band) added to the latent before diffusion for prompt-conditioned rare-regime generation (blowouts, snow games) without retraining the VAE.
gate: ADOPT TabSyn as the production synthetic-season backbone if: (a) its column-density error <= 50% of TabDDPM's on the NFL table, AND (b) real+synthetic GBDT log-loss beats real-only by >=0.003 on held-out 2024, AND (c) sampling cost <= 30 NFEs per season batch; REJECT (fall back to TabDDPM/FinDiff) if the VAE reconstruction degrades team-identity fidelity or training cost exceeds 3x TabDDPM's without meeting gate (a).

title: Rating of players by Laplace approximation and dynamic modeling
improvement: Per-match Elo variance update (Eq. 25) for GSE's NFL team/QB ratings: insert (sigma^2)' = max(B^2, sigma^2(1-AL)) into GSE's Elo updater with the reduction factor A and lower bound B (Algorithm 1 vElo as a drop-in replacement for the mean-only Elo step); tune (A,B) on train NLL - faster adaptation to new QBs/rookie breakouts without the variance-collapse pathology - plus the surface-transfer formula for NFL context splits: a team's rating on grass vs turf, dome vs outdoor, or home vs away as 'surfaces', estimating cross-split sigmas and rhos from NFL data, then propagating a Sunday result on one split to the others proportionally to correlation x SD ratio.
gate: ADOPT only if vElo wins with McNemar p < 0.05 at >= +0.3pp accuracy on 2018-2023 NFL games, time-ordered, vs constant-variance Elo; ADAPT (rookie/QB-change-only usage) if gains concentrate on new players; otherwise REJECT. Do not adopt the tennis (A,B) parameterization - re-tune (A,B) on NFL data.

title: TacticAI: an AI assistant for football tactics
improvement: Two props wins: (1) receiver-conditional TD model for anytime-TD and receiving props: P(TD on play) = sum_t P(TD | targeted=t)*P(targeted=t) - train a target-distribution model (who gets targeted from pre-snap/matchup features) and a conditional TD model (given the target, from coverage/separation features), marginalize; same for first-down props; (2) pre-snap graph for the NGS lane: 22 nodes with NGS positions/velocities at snap, edges = offense/defense + assignment proximity, GATv2 predicting play outcome (run/pass, yards bucket, TD), with D2-style augmentation: mirror across field axis (with play-direction normalization) to double goal-line/red-zone samples - plus situation retrieval: nearest-neighbor search in the graph embedding space for matchup prep ('find me all 3rd-and-long blitz looks vs this protection').
gate: ADOPT the graph + conditional-decomposition stack iff it improves holdout log-loss by >= 5% over the tabular baseline on 2025 plays (paired bootstrap, p < 0.05); if only the decomposition wins (without the GNN), adopt that alone; otherwise REJECT.

title: A decoder-only foundation model for time-series forecasting
improvement: Build a sports TimesFM: NFL-specific corpus - weekly team-level sequences 2002-2024 (offensive/defensive EPA per play/game, success rate, score margin, pace, QB-starter injury proxies), NCAA FBS margins, market lines, plus the paper's synthetic recipe adapted to sports (ARMA+seasonality+trend generators calibrated to NFL margins, mean ~0, sigma ~13.5); decoder-only transformer (input patch 8, output patch 16, dim 1024, 12 layers, random masking) with a multi-quantile output head (10 quantiles) instead of MSE; pretrain on synthetic + NFL history, fine-tune per-season on expanding windows; weekly batch inference Tuesday (line release) and Sunday morning (final); CRPS-gated rollout - plus a hybrid pretraining curriculum: cheap synthetic sports-like series (NFL-margin ARMA family with regime shifts for coaching changes) first, then real NFL/NCAA sequences, testing whether regime-shift synthetic generators teach faster adaptation to new coaching staffs/QBs.
gate: ADOPT the sports-TimesFM into the engine if, on the 2022-2023 holdout, the fine-tuned quantile model achieves >=0.005 lower mean CRPS than the naive seasonal-margin baseline AND beats it in both seasons individually; REJECT (keep researching, do not ship) if it fails either season or the gain is <0.005; reject unconditionally if any leakage audit flag fires.

title: Ratings of European and South American Football Leagues Based on Glicko-2 with Modifications
improvement: Implement modified Glicko-2 on NFL (nflverse 2002-2025): standard mu/phi/sigma with paper-ported modifications - (a) home advantage h inside the expectation function (tuned; no pandemic split), (b) season-start update: phi += phi_s and mu += mu_l for teams with >=40% roster turnover (free-agency/draft churn proxy for league-change drift), (c) post-season normalization of the league mean to a fixed constant, (d) drop the draw term; compare Glicko-2 log-loss against GSE's existing Elo baseline on the same games; output per-team (mu, phi) each week - phi (rating deviation) as the new uncertainty signal GSE's point ratings lack - plus an ablation the paper never did: toggle each modification independently on the NFL test block, then try team-specific h_i (e.g. altitude Denver) with hierarchical shrinkage across the 32 teams.
gate: ADOPT modified Glicko-2 if it beats BOTH baselines by >=0.004 mean log-loss on the 2021-2025 test block, with the gain robust when 2020 (COVID season) is excluded; ADAPT if it beats only one baseline (keep the winning modification subset); REJECT if it beats neither.

title: Fairer and More Accurate Tabular Models Through NAS
improvement: Multi-objective NAS+HPO: search space = MLP/ResNet/FT-Transformer architectures (rtdl-style) + training HPs, objectives = (a) log-loss on OOF, (b) ECE on OOF; optimizer: ParEGO or NSGA-II over the two objectives; use case = the win-probability tabular model, where calibration directly prices Kelly stakes - from the Pareto front, pick the knee point and compare against the current log-loss-only champion + post-hoc isotonic - plus a THIRD objective: inference latency (or equivalently ensemble size), making it accuracy-calibration-latency 3D Pareto search; test whether a latency-constrained Pareto pick (<=100ms/game inference) sacrifices >0.002 log-loss vs unconstrained.
gate: ADOPT if: the Pareto knee config beats the log-loss-champion+isotonic baseline on BOTH log-loss (>=0.001) and ECE (>=10% relative) on the 2023-2025 holdout - i.e. joint search finds something post-hoc calibration cannot; REJECT if: the Pareto front shows no config dominating the single-objective champion on both axes, or search cost exceeds 100 GPU-hours for <0.001 log-loss gain.

title: Theoretically Grounded Loss Functions and Algorithms for Score-Based Multi-Class Abstention
improvement: Two-stage no-bet head on the frozen engine: stage 1 = current engine (frozen); stage 2 = train a rejector (gradient boosting / small MLP) on historical engine outputs + game features, with labels = 1 if the engine's pick was wrong (or unprofitable), 0 otherwise, using exponential loss Phi(t)=exp(-t) per the paper, and abstention cost c tuned to a target no-bet rate - the rejector sees the engine's predicted edge, CQR width, line-move features, OOD score, subsuming the confidence-threshold, kNN-reject, and double-score gate scores from ledgers 1006, 1010, and 1011 as inputs - plus a multi-class extension: GSE publishes spread, total, and moneyline - train a SHARED rejector with class-specific abstention costs, testing whether the paper's multi-class machinery beats three independent binary rejectors.
gate: ADOPT if the two-stage rejector beats the confidence-threshold baseline on abstention loss by >=15% relative (paired test p<0.05) AND beats it on profit; otherwise REJECT. The single decisive number: abstention-loss reduction >= 15% vs confidence-threshold baseline.

title: Predictor-Rejector Multi-Class Abstention: Theoretical Analysis and Algorithms
improvement: Predictor-rejector no-bet head (P-R, two-stage): freeze engine h; train rejector r on a DIFFERENT feature set: line-move magnitude/timing, reverse-line-movement flags, CQR interval width, ensemble disagreement (1009's p*), OOD distance (1011's score_B), news-volume anomaly; surrogate = exponential loss on the rejector per the paper's two-stage family; abstention cost c mapped from the sportsbook vig (a wrong pick costs ~1.1 units of a 1-unit bet; abstention costs 0); tune the accept/reject threshold to a target no-bet rate - plus a deferral cascade: instead of binary abstain, route into THREE tiers - publish (engine confident), human review (Garrett, the 'defer to human' special case the paper's framing explicitly supports), and hard no-bet.
gate: ADOPT if two-stage P-R beats two-stage score-based on abstention loss by >=5% relative (paired p<0.05) OR beats the confidence baseline by >=15% relative with rejection ratio <= 30%; otherwise REJECT. The single decisive number: abstention-loss reduction >= 5% vs two-stage score-based (or >=15% vs confidence baseline) at rejection ratio <= 0.30.

title: Quantile Super Learning for independent and online settings with application to solar power forecasting
improvement: Build a Quantile Super Learner for GSE prop distributions: for each prop market, collect K candidate quantile curves (per-alpha predictions from GSE's projection models + market-implied quantiles inverted from lines); select/combine via rolling-window cross-validated quantile loss (walk-forward, refit weekly); use the continuous variant (convex weights on a simplex grid) for stability, weights >= 0, sum = 1, optimized on the trailing 6-8 weeks of resolved props; output combined quantile function per player-prop, deriving fair P(over) by interpolating at the posted line - plus regime-aware QSL: fit separate weight vectors per regime (pre/post key-injury, dome/outdoor, divisional) selected by a context gate, testing whether regime-gated weights beat global weights on tail-quantile (alpha in {0.1, 0.9}) loss.
gate: ADAPT accepted: walk-forward mean quantile loss >= 3% lower (relative) than the simple-average baseline AND >= 1% lower than EWA, with no single week worse than 5% above the best baseline (robustness); else REJECT. Hard fail: if continuous-QSL weights collapse to a single candidate every week (adds nothing over discrete selection), reject as non-value-add.

title: TabRepo: A Large Scale Repository of Tabular Model Evaluations and its AutoML Applications
improvement: Build 'GSE-TabRepo': every model config ever evaluated on every season/market task gets logged (config, OOF predictions, log-loss, fit/inference time) into a permanent evaluations table; markets = spread/total/moneyline x game/team-week granularities; offseason portfolio learning: run the greedy complementarity algorithm over the accumulated table to learn a portfolio of ~15-30 configs; each new season, evaluate ONLY the portfolio on the most recent season (zero-shot), then ensemble-select the top members; guard against non-stationarity by learning the portfolio on rolling 5-season windows, re-derived each offseason - plus a conditional portfolio: a small decision rule mapping season meta-features (pace, scoring environment, market efficiency stats) to a subset of configs, testing whether the conditional portfolio beats the static one by >=0.001 log-loss on held-out seasons.
gate: ADOPT if: the portfolio-ensemble matches the full-search log-loss within 0.002 on 2023-2025 while using <=25% of the compute, AND the learned portfolio is stable (>=60% member overlap between consecutive offseason derivations); REJECT if: portfolio log-loss is worse than full search by >0.002, or a regime-shift season makes the portfolio pick a catastrophically bad member.

title: Tabular Few-Shot Generalization Across Heterogeneous Feature Spaces
improvement: Meta-learn tabular models across NFL eras: nflverse game-level tabular features 2015-2025, tasks at team-season level with deliberately varying feature subsets per era (drop NGS columns pre-2018, drop tracking pre-2021) to exercise heterogeneous transfer; column encoder over game-stat columns, dataset encoder over the K-game support set, GAT target network with generated weights; binary head (win/loss, cover/no-cover) plus a regression head for margin (linear head on pooled node states); meta-train across eras, meta-test on 2023-2025 new regimes; FLATadapt at inference: 5-10 gradient steps on the support set's embeddings only; per-team weekly serving with no refit of the meta-network - plus a Hybrid FLAT-NGGP head: replace the softmax classifier with ledger 1902's flow-conditioned GP head, outputting calibrated non-Gaussian predictive distributions over margin instead of class labels.
gate: ADOPT iff FLAT beats per-task XGBoost by >=3pp accuracy on new-regime win prediction at K in {2,4} (2023-2025 LOSO) AND the heterogeneous-schema variant loses <=1pp vs the homogeneous variant; reject if it cannot beat plain XGBoost at K=4.

title: Bayes-xG: Player and Position Correction on Expected Goals (xG) using Bayesian Hierarchical Approach
improvement: Hierarchical CPOE as the principled Bayesian upgrade to GSE's ad-hoc shrinkage: hierarchical logistic regression with QB-level (or receiver-level) random effects on completion probability given the nflfastR-style feature set - partial pooling handles small-sample QBs; position-group adjustments for EPA models (TE/RB/WR group effects on EPA/play or success rate) with the paper's key caution: apparent 'position effects' may vanish once situational features (coverage, pressure) are included; adopt the prior-sensitivity protocol (fit wide/tight/ill-suited variants, compare MSD) as the template for any GSE Bayesian model - plus: empirical-Bayes / cross-validated player priors instead of reputation alpha, team-level crossed random effects (QB vs scheme vs supporting cast), extension from binary outcomes to ordered EPA buckets (hierarchical ordered logit).
gate: ADOPT only if the reproduction gate holds (recover Table 5 positional adjustments within +/-0.005 on StatsBomb EPL open data), the prior battery ranks the chosen priors first, AND hierarchical wins held-out log-loss on small-sample QBs (<200 attempts); ADAPT (research prior) if it only matches; otherwise REJECT.

title: Towards A Foundation Model For Trajectory Intelligence
improvement: Build the 3-stage trajectory tokenizer on NFL 10Hz tracking: quantize field to fine cells (~0.5-yd); map each (player, frame) to a hierarchical cell hash; cell-hash encoding -> spatiotemporal clustering (~0.3 s window, adjacent-cell merge to denoise jitter) -> WordPiece sub-hash tokenization to a 30-50k vocab trained on 7 seasons of tracking; pretrain BERT-style masked trajectory model (whole-cell pre-masking 20%) on tokenized play sequences; use token embeddings as input features for GSE prop models, or fine-tune task heads (ball-carrier destination prediction; player-style identification) - plus: (1) add the temporal dimension - interleave delta-t tokens and train with time-aware masking (mask bursts, not just hexagons); (2) hierarchical sub-hashes at two field resolutions (coarse zone + fine cell) as separate token streams.
gate: ADOPT if: (a) sub-hash tokenizer achieves >= 50% vocabulary reduction vs raw cell hashing at equal masked-token perplexity, AND (b) frozen-embedding ball-carrier destination prediction F1 >= 10pp above the raw-coordinate baseline on held-out weeks; REJECT if neither holds.

title: GFN-SR: Symbolic Regression with Generative Flow Networks
improvement: Reimplement GFN-SR-lite in PyTorch: LSTM policy over pre-order token sequences, in-situ constraint masks (from ledger 1824), TB loss, adaptive baseline B schedule; reward = 1/(1+NMSE) on nflverse train slice; use as a DIVERSITY generator: sample 200 post-training equations, cluster by symbolic skeleton, keep cluster medoids as the candidate metric set, feed each through the 1826 selector - plus reward shaping with the LM prior: replace vanilla R(s)=1/(1+RMSE) with R(s)*P_LM(s)^lambda where P_LM is the 1826 sports-corpus n-gram prior - sampling proportional to fit x domain-plausibility, testing whether the GFlowNet's multi-modality survives prior-shaping or collapses back to one mode.
gate: ADOPT GFN-SR as the candidate generator if its top-5 diverse set contains an equation beating DSR's single best by >=0.02 test r on 2024-2025 AND the set's cross-season stability (2024 vs 2025 rank correlation) exceeds DSR's top-5-beam stability; REJECT if sampling collapses to near-duplicates or no candidate beats the baseline.

title: On the Maximization of Long-Run Reward CVaR for Markov Decision Processes
improvement: Build the risk-seeking drawdown-recovery regime: loss frame = bankroll below its trailing peak by >=8% (drawdown >= 8%) - outside the frame, the risk-averse stack (ledgers 2142/2144/2147) governs; small tabular MDP: states = {normal, hot, cold} bankroll-momentum x {high, low} edge-availability (6 states), actions = stake tiers {0.5u, 1u, 2u, 3u}, transitions estimated from historical weekly P&L sequences, reward = weekly profit; solve the paper's two LPs for max CVaR_alpha (alpha=0.7, right tail) + beta*mean with beta tuned so mean is not sacrificed; extract the stationary randomized policy (expect <=1 randomization per Theorem 2, e.g. 'in (drawdown, high-edge): post 1u with p=0.8, 3u with p=0.2'); precompute the 6-state policy table monthly, weekly lookup by current state, log sampled actions for the audit trail - plus depth-conditioned alpha/beta (re-solve the LPs per drawdown-depth bucket) and a distributionally robust MDP variant (uncertainty set on transitions, a la 2143's outer risk).
gate: ACCEPT if walk-forward 2024-2025: recovery time from >=8% drawdown <= 0.75 x best baseline's AND final bankroll >= best baseline's AND max drawdown never exceeds 1.2 x the freeze baseline's; REJECT if recovery is not faster than flat-1u or the left-tail cost exceeds the 1.2x bound.

title: Stochastic modelling of football matches
improvement: Build an NFL live-game Cox/Hawkes-style event model as GSE's live probability engine: events = scoring events {home TD, away TD, home FG, away FG} + intensity shocks {key-player injury/ejection, weather change at open-air stadiums, referee flags}; regressors: score differential, possession state (down/distance/field position), time remaining, timeouts, pregame spread-implied strength, turnover/injury shock indicators, pace (plays per minute); log-linear intensities (concave log-likelihood -> convex solver); attack/defence normalization analogous to the paper's constraint; from any live game state, simulate 100k forward paths -> live win probability, live spread/total distributions, live derivative prices; pre-match fit runs weekly, in-game inference is simulation - plus: (1) self-exciting (Hawkes) terms for momentum bursts - a decaying excitation term on recent scoring events; (2) market-implied regressors - live market-implied team strength as a dynamic regressor updated as the market moves in-game.
gate: ADAPT into the live engine only if: (a) the mechanism check reproduces the three headline effects within +/-2 pp; AND (b) the NFL transfer test beats the pregame-spread-carry baseline on mean per-game log-likelihood over the 2024-2025 test window by a statistically significant margin (paired t-test, p < 0.05), AND (c) calibration of the simulated final-margin distribution passes a chi-squared goodness-of-fit test at alpha = 0.05.

title: Luck, skill, and depth of competition in games and social hierarchies
improvement: As engine-honesty infrastructure, build a GSE luck+depth rating layer: fit alpha, beta per league (and per season) on GSE's game data - alpha becomes the league's irreducible upset rate, beta its depth; use alpha as a miscalibration diagnostic: compare model-implied underdog win rates vs market-implied, flagging mispriced underdogs when alpha-hat gaps between model and market persist; use beta to set the rating scale's steepness per league instead of a global constant; port to a fast MAP/laplace approximation for production (Stan HMC is the prototype, not the serving path) - plus time-varying depth: let beta(t) drift within a season (early-season parity vs late-season stratification), testing whether dynamic beta beats static beta on rolling log-likelihood as a 'league stratification index' for content and modeling.
gate: ADAPT confirmed if luck+depth BT beats plain BT on 2025 NFL walk-forward log-likelihood by >=0.003/game with the alpha-hat estimate stable across halves of the season (confounding check: |alpha-hat_H1 - alpha-hat_H2| < 0.05); if alpha/beta confound (unstable alpha-hat), fall back to the depth-only variant.

title: auto-sktime: Automated Time Series Forecasting
improvement: Adopt the two mechanisms, not the system: (a) lookback-window successive halving as the fidelity schedule for GSE's forecaster/model selection - evaluate candidate configurations on the most recent 2 seasons (low fidelity), promote winners to 5 seasons, then full history; (b) warm-start each season's HPO from the previous season's optimization trace (store evaluated configs + scores in the feature store); wraps the existing win-probability model HPO and the AG-TS panel forecaster (ledger 1983) - plus regime-aware fidelity: choose the low-fidelity window by detecting the most recent stable regime (e.g. post-coaching-change or post-QB-change break) instead of a fixed 2->5->full season ladder, testing whether regime-aware windows beat fixed recency windows as a fidelity proxy.
gate: ADOPT the mechanisms if: successive halving selects a config within 2% wQL of the full-evaluation winner while using <=40% of the compute, AND warm-starting reaches the from-scratch best within <=50% of the evaluations on the 2024-2025 windows; REJECT if: the low-fidelity winner disagrees with the full-fidelity winner on >1 of 3 test seasons, or warm-start shows no evaluation savings vs random init.

title: Enhancing Trajectory Prediction through Self-Supervised Waypoint Noise Prediction (SSWNP)
improvement: Wrap GSE's trajectory predictor with SSWNP: ball-carrier observed 1.0 s (10 frames) -> predict 2.0 s (20 frames); duplicate each batch into clean + noise-augmented views (omega tuned on validation, start 0.05 in field-normalized units); add noise-prediction head Theta_ss on the encoder; L_total = L_sup + lambda*L_ss, lambda from L_ss convergence (paper: 0.01); validate omega in {0.01, 0.05, 0.1}; ~1 engineer-week (training-loop change + one auxiliary head; zero inference overhead) - plus: (1) structured noise - perturb waypoints along the motion direction (speed noise) vs perpendicular (lateral noise) separately, testing which teaches more useful invariances (cuts are lateral; bursts are longitudinal); (2) adversarial-noise scheduling: increase omega over training (curriculum), testing whether late-training high-noise views further improve robustness.
gate: ADOPT if: (a) SSWNP-trained predictor reduces FDE >= 10% vs the same-backbone baseline on held-out weeks, AND (b) under test-time jitter, the SSWNP model's FDE degradation is <= half the baseline's degradation; REJECT if neither holds.

title: Gambling under unknown probabilities as a proxy for real world decisions under uncertainty
improvement: Build the 'delta/sigma gate' for GSE stakes: estimate sigma per market type (spread/moneyline/total, and per edge bucket) as the RMSE of engine win-prob vs realized outcomes on a rolling window (the calibration curve's RMSE); for each pick with perceived edge delta_perc = p_engine - p_market, compute the expected-growth factor from (17); stake only if E[growth] > 0 with margin (e.g. delta_perc > 1.5 sigma), and scale the Kelly fraction by Phi(delta_perc/sigma) (probability the perceived edge has the right sign); re-derive (16)-(17) for general decimal odds before coding (replace a=2delta with f*=(bp-q)/b and redo the xi-integration numerically) - plus a distribution-free version: replace the normal-xi assumption with the engine's empirical error distribution (bootstrap residuals from the calibration history) and recompute the optimal stake by direct numerical integration.
gate: ADOPT the delta/sigma gate if gated Kelly beats ungated Kelly on terminal log growth with max drawdown no worse, over 2023-2025, with the improvement concentrated in picks where delta_perc/sigma < 1.5 (the gate's target population); REJECT if the gate just throws away good bets (growth drops).

title: Vertical Symbolic Regression
improvement: Implement VSR-PySR: round r runs PySR restricted to growing feature subsets S_1 subset S_2 subset ..., seeding each round's population with the previous round's hall-of-fame; approximate control via residualizing on controlled features' current best form, and observational control by binning controlled variables (down/distance buckets) and fitting reduced forms per bin - plus regime-vertical SR: run the vertical rounds over game regimes (round 1: neutral-script plays; round 2: +trailing; round 3: +leading), testing whether football relationships are regime-decomposable.
gate: ADOPT vertical staging if VSR-PySR matches or beats horizontal test R^2 with <=50% of the expression length or <=50% of the compute time; REJECT if horizontal wins on both accuracy and simplicity - the oracle-free approximation does not transfer.

title: Performance rating in chess, tennis, and other contexts
improvement: Build a PRe module: given an NFL team/unit over an n-game window with per-game pre-game win probabilities w_i, compute the binomial-exact score probability at window-average and solve the paper's constrained max for the implied rating, back-translated to Elo-scale PRe - for content leaderboards ('best defensive 5-game stretch') and as a (PRe - Elo) gap feature - replacing the paper's fixed t=0.75 and average-opponent collapse with the exact sequence likelihood MLE on Pi_i Bernoulli(w_i * shift).
gate: ADOPT the PRe module if (a) theorem replication on NFL windows holds within +/-1 Elo point for 0<m<n (mathematical port validated), AND (b) the (PRe - Elo) gap feature improves next-game ATS-residual adjusted R^2 by >=0.002 vs Elo-only on 2015-2025 time-ordered CV; ADAPT as content-only (leaderboard product, no modeling use) if (a) holds but (b) fails.

title: The many routes to the ubiquitous Bradley–Terry model
improvement: As engine-honesty infrastructure, add a ratings license checklist in GSE's ratings pipeline: before promoting any pairwise rating model, run assumption diagnostics - (a) transitivity/intransitivity test on the win matrix; (b) quasi-symmetry residual check (PageRank/fair-bets comparison); (c) tie-model comparison (Davidson vs Rao-Kupper vs ignore); (d) MaxEnt-vs-MLE worths comparison - plus a failure-diagnostic dashboard tracking the intransitivity index and quasi-symmetry residuals weekly, triggering automatic re-selection among BT variants (plain / Davidson / Poisson-scoring) when thresholds cross.
gate: ADAPT confirmed if, on the 2025 NFL season held-out set, the tie-aware or multi-outcome BT variant selected by the diagnostics beats the plain-BT baseline log-likelihood by >=0.005 per game (paired test p<0.05); if no variant beats plain BT, the diagnostics still stand as guardrails (gate passes on diagnostic implementation, not on finding a violation).

title: Deep Generative Symbolic Regression
improvement: Reimplement DGSR-lite: Set Transformer encoder + Transformer decoder with tree-state embeddings, pre-trained on synthetic sports-plausible equations (from the NSR Phase-2 generator) with d=4-8 variables; at inference, encode nflverse slices and run NGPQT-style refinement (or REINFORCE fine-tuning on NMSE) before Monte-Carlo MAP search - with a refinement curriculum: refine first on GP-denoised targets, then raw data, testing whether staged refinement beats single-stage on recovery of known synthetic sports equations with injected noise.
gate: ADOPT inference-time refinement if it improves held-out RMSE by >=8% over no-refinement decoding at equal-or-fewer equation evaluations on the 2024-2025 window; REJECT if refinement gains vanish on noisy real data or merely recover the pre-training prior's favorite shapes.

title: Sports-QA: A Large-Scale Video Question Answering Benchmark for Complex and Professional Sports
improvement: Treat NGS tracking sequences as the 'video' for football QA: transformer encoder over tracking frames with AFA-style multi-focal attention (focal lengths {5,25,100} frames ~ {0.5s,2.5s,10s}), question encoder replaced by a play-context encoder (down/distance, personnel, score) - 'what happens next' play-outcome classification - with focal lengths learnable per attention head and mixing weights alpha_f conditioned on play context (short focus for line-of-scrimmage chaos, long focus for developing routes).
gate: Adopt if AFA beats standard attention by >=1.5pp accuracy AND >=1.0pp macro-F1 on the 2024 holdout; reject otherwise (the paper's own margin is ~1.2pp - demand at least parity with that on football data).

title: Constrained Max Drawdown: a Fast and Robust Portfolio Optimization Approach
improvement: Build a GSE bet portfolio constructor: inputs = engine edge estimates + bet-outcome covariance (bootstrap from historical pick residuals, block-diagonal by game); implement the constrained-MD MILP (pulp/OR-Tools) maximizing worst historical session return with constraints >=5% per selected bet, <=50% per bet, bankroll budget - plus drawdown-adaptive bounds: run the MILP on rolling 30-day windows, tightening the minimum-allocation bound when recent realized drawdown is high.
gate: ADOPT into the sizing layer if, on the 2024 walk-forward, max bankroll drawdown is >=20% lower than flat staking at equal or better ROI; REJECT if drawdown is not reduced or ROI drops >1 pp.

title: Synergistic Formulaic Alpha Generation for Quantitative Trading based on Reinforcement Learning
improvement: Mine signals with synergy rewards: change the mining reward from individual-signal RankIC to marginal contribution (Shapley-style value added to the current ensemble's walk-forward Brier); self-bootstrap by seeding each run's pool with GSE's own accepted signals (combination may drop seeds); cap the combination pool at ~20 - plus explicit synergy accounting: add a per-candidate orthogonality bonus = 1 - max|rho| vs pool, decompose final gains into individual quality + orthogonality via ablation, and test cross-horizon synergy by mining pools at multiple horizons.
gate: ADAPT->build if synergy-rewarded mining beats individual-rewarded mining on test ensemble Brier by >= 0.002 at pool size <= 20 AND self-seeding matches or beats hand-seeding; REJECT if marginal-contribution rewards produce no ensemble gain over greedy individual selection - then 'synergy' is just a relabeled greedy forward selection.

title: Optimal strategy for trail running with nutrition and fatigue factors
improvement: Build gse_fatigue_state.py: per-player latent fatigue Q updated per play from NGS power proxy P = m*v*a, dQ/dt = K*P during sessions and dQ/dt = -rho*Q between sessions (recovery; rho fitted); calibrate K, rho per position group against observed outcomes (missed practices, snap declines, soft-tissue flags) - then add the missing recovery term and a stochastic injury-hazard layer: soft-tissue injury as a point process with intensity lambda(t) = lambda_0*exp(gamma*Q(t)), estimating lambda_0, gamma per position group and testing whether lambda(t) anticipates injuries better than ACWR-based hazards.
gate: Accepted (narrowly but genuinely): validated predictive accuracy (0.5-13% finish-time errors across 5 independent races), a mechanistic fatigue ODE directly portable to workload-state modeling, and an explicit parameter-fitting methodology. Not a plug-in predictor; a feature-engineering template.

title: OpenSkill: A faster asymmetric multi-team, multiplayer rating system
improvement: Prototype OpenSkill (Plackett-Luce) as an NFL team-rating backend: pip-install openskill.py, run weekly updates 2000-2025, benchmark against GSE's house Elo on backtest log-loss - then go beyond the paper: implement score-differential-aware Plackett-Luce updates (weight the Bayesian update by margin of victory relative to expectation) plus lightweight player-contribution weighting via snap shares (starters full update, rotational players fractional), testing whether margin-aware updates close the conceded accuracy gap.
gate: ADOPT OpenSkill as the production rating engine if it matches house Elo within 0.002 log-loss on the 2020-2024 walk-forward AND runs the full 2000-2025 weekly backtest in under 50% of the Elo pipeline's wall-clock time; REJECT (keep Elo) if the log-loss gap exceeds 0.002, if the sigma-uncertainty feature adds no Kelly-sizing value, or if margin-of-victory handling proves load-bearing and the package cannot accommodate it.

title: XGBoost Learning of Dynamic Wager Placement for In-Play Betting on an Agent-Based Model of a Sports Betting Exchange
improvement: As engine-honesty infrastructure, port the learning loop, not the horse-race policy: build a GSE in-play simulator (or use recorded NFL live-odds + win-probability traces) as the synthetic environment; define simple baseline in-play betting policies (always-back-closing-favorite, momentum-chaser, Kelly-on-live-model-edge); record their actions and profits; train XGBoost to imitate the most profitable agents' back/lay decisions from (game-state, live-market-state) features - then add the online-learning extension (policy updates during live games) and swap the binary back/lay objective for stake sizing (Kelly fraction regression).
gate: ADOPT the imitation-learning loop for GSE's in-play lane only if the learned policy beats every scripted baseline on 2025 holdout profit with p < 0.05 (Wilcoxon, as in the paper); if it merely matches the best baseline, keep the scripted policies and the recorded live-odds dataset as the asset; reject the 'learner beats teachers' claim as a simulator artifact.

title: Understanding whole-body inter-personal dynamics between two players using neural Granger causality as the explainable AI (XAI)
improvement: Build a matchup-causality module: on NFL Big Data Bowl tracking (22 players x, y, speed, direction, orientation at 10 Hz), fit neural Granger causality (cMLP) per matchup type (man-coverage CB<->WR, pass-rusher<->QB), extracting inter-body NGC indices (e.g., CB reaction-lag 0.2-0.6s) - replacing fixed-lambda tuning-to-a-usage-band with a stability-selection procedure (bootstrap-resample plays within a matchup, refit cMLP, keep links selected in >=70% of bootstraps) for per-link confidence weights in the matchup tables.
gate: Adopt into the matchup-causality module if on the 2022 weeks 1-8 man-coverage set: (a) mean CB reaction-lag index lands within 0.2-0.6s AND (b) WR->CB inter-body NGC correlates with play EPA at R^2 >= 0.10 with p < .05, and the sign persists (R^2 >= 0.05) on weeks 9-17 holdout; reject if the lag indices are unstable across hyperparameter settings or R^2 < 0.05 on the primary window.

title: Least squares for cardinal paired comparisons data
improvement: Build the LS rating engine with precision: per week, form N (Laplacian of games played) and S (score-differential sums); mu-hat=N^+S with sum-mu=0 constraint; publish team strengths WITH standard errors (sigma-hat^2=Q(mu-hat)/n, Var(mu-hat)=sigma-hat^2 N^+) - a GSE differentiator - plus pairwise z-tests for matchup content ('model says KC is better than BUF at 95% confidence, accounting for schedule connectivity'), rejecting the omit-home-covariate simplification for NFL, and an optimal-design lane: weekly 'highest-leverage games for rating precision' via A-optimality (reduction in trace(sigma^2 N^+) per unplayed game).
gate: ADOPT the N^+ precision engine if the coverage test passes at 93-97% - then ship SEs on all GSE LS ratings and the pairwise z-tests for content; REJECT the exponential rank-confidence claim for weekly tiers unless the subgaussian error bound is validated.

title: Investigating Fouling Efficiency in Football Using Expected Booking (xB) Model
improvement: Build an NFL xFlag (expected-penalty) model: per-play penalty probability conditioned on game state and officiating - down/distance, yardline, score differential, time, team prior penalty rate, referee crew, EPA of the pre-flag play, pass/run, defender pressure rate; XGBoost/LightGBM binary classifier; outputs expected flags per game by team (xFlags), per-crew tendencies, drive-level expected free yards, fed into the drive/game simulation to adjust totals and spread - with referee-crew embeddings (learned per-crew booking-tendency vectors) and a two-stage hurdle model (flag/no-flag -> yardage conditional on flag).
gate: ADOPT the xFlag sub-model into GSE's game simulation only if: (a) out-of-sample AUC >= 0.58 on 2023-2024 hold-outs AND (b) adding xFlag to the totals simulation reduces MAE on closing totals by >= 0.3 points over 2023-2024 (n~=540 games); otherwise keep as research note only.

title: Biases in Expected Goals Models Confound Finishing Ability
improvement: Add a residual-hygiene module to the props pipeline: (1) K-fold cross-fitting so no player's residual is computed from a model trained on his own plays (kills self-contamination); (2) multi-calibration of expected-yards models within position x volume bins with empirical-Bayes priors per position; (3) atypical-play exclusion list (tipped passes, Hail Marys, kneel-downs, spikes) from both training and residual evaluation; (4) volume-dependent shrinkage of all published player residual ratings toward positional means - plus a learned-grouping experiment: decision tree on the residual surface to discover the grouping maximizing residual heterogeneity, multi-calibrating within learned groups.
gate: ADOPT cross-fitting + multi-calibration as mandatory pipeline hygiene if EITHER: (a) removing top-5 volume RBs changes their measured yards-above-expected by >=5% (contamination effect); or (b) cross-fit/multi-calibrated residuals predict next-season efficiency better than raw residuals by >=0.03 correlation points; if neither holds, document the null and keep cross-fitting anyway as cheap insurance.

title: Individual and team performance in cricket
improvement: Port four mechanisms to NFL: (1) era normalization nf = <league scoring>_all / <league scoring>_season for cross-era player comps; (2) NFL fractional contribution fc = 1/2*(player yards/team yards + player EPA/team EPA) as a single-game 'how much of the team was this guy' score for player ratings and anytime-TD reasoning; (3) effective team size S_eff as an injury-vulnerability index - low S_eff = concentrated production = a star injury moves the number more - fed into spread/total adjustments when a high-share player is Q/OUT, with a Herfindahl-style concentration measure weighted by positional replaceability; (4) hot-streak shuffle-null tests (1,000 timestamp-shuffled nulls) as features in anytime-TD/yardage-prop models.
gate: ADOPT the S_eff injury-vulnerability index iff the S_eff x star-OUT interaction term is significant (p < 0.05) with the correct sign (low S_eff -> bigger line move) on 2023-2025 injury events; ADOPT fc ratings iff they predict next-week EPA with lower MAE than a rolling-EPA baseline; otherwise REJECT.

title: A comprehensive survey of the home advantage in American football
improvement: Add a Bayesian paired-comparison home-advantage module to the engine: score-differential outcomes on nflverse game logs, season-specific team strengths, league HA term with linear drift - fit weekly, feeding the posterior-mean HA as the engine's home-field term instead of a static 3 (2023 estimate 1.73 pts, ~0.65-point 20-year decline) - with decline-trend detection via P(beta_1 < 0) over a rolling 10-year window (re-baseline if P(decline) > 0.9), strength-adjusted HA features for college lanes, and extensions for betting use: dynamic state-space team strengths, a spline/changepoint term on HA for replay-adoption discontinuities, and crew-level random effects for officiating home bias.
gate: ADAPT iff a Stan refit of Model 2 on nflverse NFL data reproduces a 2023 NFL home advantage within the paper's 95% credible interval (1.07-2.39 points); failure to replicate the decline signal or HA magnitude means GSE's home-edge implementation cannot trust this paper's calibration.

title: Multi-Camera Asynchronous Ball Localization and Trajectory Prediction with Factor Graphs and Human Poses
improvement: Build an NFL punt/kickoff flight lab: factor graph with variables (ball 3D pos/vel, spin vector, orientation quaternion for a football) and factors - projection, drag+Magnus lift, gravity, a learned bounce/turf factor, and a spin-prior factor from a TCN on kicker pose (15 frames before foot contact) - implemented with GTSAM/ISAM2 (incremental = real-time capable); serve offline over historical kick plays for a 'kick quality vs outcome' table, online variant feeding the live win-probability engine on kickoffs (touchback probability before the ball lands) - testing learned-vs-analytic bounce factors on tumbling punts.
gate: ADOPT if on held-out NFL punts: (a) landing-spot RMSE <= 2.0 yards, AND (b) pose-based spin priors cut early-flight prediction error >=30% vs the no-spin factor graph, AND (c) incremental inference runs <50 ms per detection (real-time viable); reject if the TCN spin prior shows no correlation (R<0.3) with fitted spin on NFL data.

title: Algorithmic Robust Forecast Aggregation
improvement: Implement the paper's log-odds-style robust aggregator with the tuned mixture parameter in GSE's ensemble layer - input = member-model win probabilities, output = combined probability - extending beyond two experts to the n-expert generalization (averaging pairwise applications or fitting the natural extension, measuring regret vs the two-expert rule) - plus a data-driven variant: estimate the empirical joint distribution of member-model forecasts conditional on outcomes from the picks history, then solve the restricted minimax game against an adversary perturbing within a TVD ball of the empirical structure.
gate: ADOPT into the ensemble if, on the 2025 walk-forward test, Brier score improves by >=0.002 and log-loss improves by >=0.005 vs. the current combiner, with Diebold-Mariano p<0.05 on both; robustness sub-gate: the aggregator must not lose to the baseline in any single month-slice by more than 0.003 Brier (worst-case behavior is the point of this paper).

title: Predicting Batting Averages in Specific Matchups Using Generalized Linked Matrix Factorization
improvement: Port GLMF (heterogeneous linked matrix factorization) to NFL matchup matrices: X = receiver x defense (or QB x defense) binomial matrix (completions/targets, EPA>0 plays/snaps) with aggregate offense/defense stats (normal) as Y/Z side matrices - the direct NFL analog of the paper's batter/pitcher setup - reimplemented from Li & Gaynanova (2018) heterogeneous IRLS + O'Connell & Lock (2019) LMF alternating scheme, swapping the paper's weak aggregate Y/Z for NGS-grade side data (separation, pressure rates, coverage shells) and extending to additional linked matrices (weather, venue, referee crew).
gate: ADOPT only if GLMF beats the current GSE shrinkage/matchup prior by a statistically significant log-likelihood margin with zero convergence failures across folds; ADAPT (offline research prior) if it only matches; otherwise REJECT.

title: Unified Training of Universal Time Series Forecasting Transformers (Moirai)
improvement: Fine-tune Moirai-Base on the sports pile with multivariate game-day groups (margin, total, QB EPA, RB/WR usage as variates) + future-known covariates (rest, dome, spread) with expanding-window seasonal fine-tuning - serving joint predictive distributions per game for consistent spread/total/prop pricing (no more independent models disagreeing) - with a key-number discrete head: augment the mixture output with point masses at margins {3, 7, 10} (learned weights), testing CRPS + calibration near key numbers vs the pure mixture head.
gate: ADOPT for joint spread/total pricing if fine-tuned Moirai's margin CRPS <= best univariate variant AND total CRPS <= best univariate variant on 2021-2024 (joint >= independent, plus consistency wins); ADAPT further if joint beats on one target but not both; REJECT the zero-shot weights for live use if they trail seasonal naive on either target; hard reject on any covariate-leakage flag.

title: 1626 An Optimality Property of the Bayes–Kelly Algorithm
improvement: Build a Bayes-Kelly miscalibration monitor: define a conformity score on each settled pick (signed log-loss residual of engine probability vs outcome); implement the tractable Bayes-Kelly special case with a simple parametric alternative (Beta-family miscalibration); run the test martingale over the settled-pick stream per market (spreads, totals, props separately); wire thresholds - martingale crossing L1 -> halve stakes; crossing L2 -> abstain until mean-reversion - with an empirical-Bayes prior refit monthly on GSE's own miscalibration history.
gate: ADOPT if the Bayes-Kelly monitor detects the injected miscalibration regimes at least 30% faster (fewer bets to L1) than the rolling-calibration-error baseline at equal false-alarm rates; otherwise REJECT.

title: MOMENT: A Family of Open Time-series Foundation Models
improvement: Build the 'Sports Time Series Pile' (NFL/NCAA team margins + totals 2002-2024, player weekly usage/fantasy points, NGS-derived team metrics, odds-line histories - normalized to fixed windows, released internally as the GSE pretraining corpus) and pretrain a MOMENT-style encoder (patched, RevIN, masked) on it with forecasting + classification (injury-out? regime-shift?) heads on one backbone - with a cross-channel attention probe: pretrain a variant with cross-variate attention over grouped series (team margin + total + QB EPA as one multivariate patch set), testing whether the multivariate variant beats channel-independent on same-team multi-target forecasting.
gate: ADOPT the sports-MOMENT backbone if it beats the N-BEATS baseline on the two-season holdout with >=2% MSE gain AND the masked-pretraining ablation shows pretraining contributes >=1 pt of that gain (else the gain is just architecture, and a simpler model ships); REJECT for live use if fine-tuned MAE does not beat GSE's current engine margin MAE; hard reject on any pretraining-window leakage into test seasons.

title: The Strain of Success: A Predictive Model for Injury Risk Mitigation and Team Success in Soccer
improvement: Build an NFL load-management decision tool: (1) injury-risk model - gradient boosting or survival model predicting per-player game-miss probability from trailing workload (snaps, touches, days rest, travel, surface, age, prior injury history); (2) existing GSE EPA-based team ratings as the team-strength model; (3) optimizer for rest-vs-play decisions for veterans in low-leverage weeks (Week 18, short-week Thursdays) via expected-points MDP framing with playoff-seeding value replacing raw points - with a competing-risks survival extension: time-to-injury with cause-specific hazards (soft-tissue vs contact vs concussion), the optimizer acting only on the load-attributable (preventable) risk component.
gate: ADOPT the injury-risk model only if it beats the snap-count heuristic by >=0.005 Brier on the 2024 chronological holdout with team-clustered bootstrap CIs excluding zero AND the top risk decile has >=2x the base injury rate; REJECT the rest-optimizer for betting/DFS use if the observational backtest cannot reject the null - keep it as content-only ('load management watch').

title: Peer Expectation in Robust Forecast Aggregation
improvement: Build a peer-expectation feature for each engine component (component forecast + peer proxy = historical average deviation from consensus, or market consensus as the 'peer forecast'), implementing the paper's weighted hard-sigmoid aggregator over (forecast, peer-expectation) pairs - then replace the static peer proxy with a learned peer-expectation model (predicting each component's deviation from consensus from game context: week, home/away, market move direction), feeding predicted peer expectations into the hard-sigmoid rule to measure the marginal value of the peer channel on real correlated model panels.
gate: ADOPT the peer-feature aggregator if on the 2025 walk-forward it improves Brier by >=0.002 over the forecasts-only combiner (DM p<0.05) and does not lose on log-loss; REJECT (keep forecasts-only) otherwise; if the gain exists but is <0.002, log as a negative result and do not ship.

title: 0009 Fine-Tuned Large Event Models (arXiv:2402.06815v2)
improvement: Build team-contextualized next-play event models: (1) general NFL event model trained on nflverse play-by-play 2020-2025 (all teams): inputs = pre-play state (down, distance, yardline, score, time, personnel groupings, motion indicators); targets = play type, yards gained bucket, success; (2) per-team fine-tuning on that team's recent games (last 2 seasons, home+away) with reduced LR and early stopping -> 32 team-contextualized simulators; (3) matchup-conditioned fine-tuning with a proper predictive holdout - fine-tune team A's offense vs team B's defense using both teams' histories, validated strictly on future seasons, benchmarked against Elo AND GSE's existing state-space ratings (opponent adjustment is most of the signal in the NFL); (4) player-what-if queries ('how would player X perform in team Y's context') treated as scenario explorations, never predictions; serving: offline simulator for matchup/scenario analysis at the research desk, not a user-facing pick product.
gate: ADOPT the fine-tuning recipe only if: the fine-tuned team-context models beat the Elo simulation baseline by >= 1.0 win MAE on the held-out season AND beat the un-fine-tuned general model by >= 0.5 wins MAE (proving the team-context fine-tuning, not just the general model, carries the gain); REJECT if fine-tuned models do not beat Elo, or if the general-vs-fine-tuned gap is nil.

title: Forecasting Events in Soccer Matches Through Language
improvement: Build an NFL play-sequence simulator: encode each play as a token tuple (play_type, yards_gained, down, distance, yardline, quarter/time_remaining, score_diff, timeouts, shotgun/no_huddle flag, weather bin) - a 60-90-token ordinal-encoded vocabulary; single Transformer (NFL has ~700k+ plays) predicting one token at a time with the paper's masked-sampler design (only sample tokens valid for the current play-slot position); red-zone / 2-minute drill as the 'reset point' analog for error control; pregame-neutral contexts on 2015-2022, validate 2023, test 2024 (time-ordered); pregame, run ~100k simulations per game from the opening-kickoff state for win probability, total distribution, and any-play prop quantiles; in-game, re-simulate each commercial break for live edges vs sportsbook totals - plus an 'injury/ejection' token: feed beat-reporter injury tweets through an LLM classifier into the event vocabulary as a pseudo-event type (PERSONNEL_CHANGE), so the simulator's context updates when a star QB exits.
gate: ADOPT the simulator design if: next-play-type accuracy >= 62% on held-out 2024 NFL season AND win-probability calibration (Brier) on 2024 games <= GSE's current model v5.2.7 win-probability Brier on the same games; REJECT if either fails.

title: Dual Likelihood for Causal Inference under Structure Uncertainty
improvement: Add dual-likelihood 95% confidence regions for causal effects under structure uncertainty: for each high-confidence edge in the quarterly causal graph (ledgers 1962-1966 consensus), compute the dual-likelihood 95% confidence region for the total causal effect (e.g. C(pressure rate -> defensive EPA/play)) - prune ordering space with the DAGuerreotype ordering (ledger 1966) before the bottom-up search; compute regions for the top-20 edges by |effect|; store (edge, effect CI) in the graph artifact; content rule: any published causal claim must cite the interval, claims whose CI covers 0 are downgraded to 'associated with' language - plus a variance-robustness layer: drop equal-variance via computing regions under a grid of variance-ratio bounds (sigma^2_max/sigma^2_min <= kappa for kappa in {1,2,5}), reporting how CIs widen as kappa grows, giving a principled ranking of which causal claims survive realistic variance heterogeneity.
gate: ADOPT dual-likelihood CIs for published causal claims if: (a) simulation coverage >= 0.93 at d=20, n=380; (b) real-data runtime < 10 min for 20 edges with pruning; (c) the intervals are informative - median width <= 2x the oracle-structure width; reject if coverage < 0.90 or median width > 3x oracle.

title: Multimodal Action Quality Assessment
improvement: Build play-execution quality regression with adaptive modality fusion: predict per-play EPA (or PFF-style grade proxy) from (a) broadcast-video features, (b) tracking-derived 'flow' features (player velocities - the analog of optical flow), (c) stadium audio (crowd noise level, snap cadence); keep the Adaptive Fusion Module with PolicyNet - the learned per-segment fusion weights become an interpretable 'which signal mattered when' readout (e.g. audio weight spikes pre-snap on false starts); train modality branches separately (tracking branch on EPA labels first), then freeze video/tracking and tune the fusion (the paper's two-phase recipe); use: (1) a play-quality feature for the engine, (2) content ('the model says crowd noise decided this drive' graphics), (3) a diagnostic - if the PolicyNet consistently zeroes a modality, drop it (cost saving) - plus event-anchored PolicyNet: anchor fusion decisions to football's natural phases (pre-snap, post-snap-to-throw, catch-point, tackle) with a separate ranked FusionNet bank per phase and a phase classifier gating them.
gate: ACCEPT: adaptive fusion beats BOTH the tracking-only model (Spearman +0.03) AND naive weighted fusion (+0.02) on the 2024 test; REJECT: fails to beat naive fusion or loses to tracking-only. Pre-registered before running.

title: SportsMetrics: Blending Text and Numerical Data to Understand Information Fusion in LLMs
improvement: Build 'GSE Stat-Claim Harness v1' (content-QC, not engine): 50 recent NFL games' nflverse play-by-play + official box scores (public, reproducible); tasks: (1) pbp -> JSON stat fill (team points, passing/rushing yards, turnovers, sacks); (2) masked-recap fill-in on GSE's own published DFS write-ups; (3) affiliation-swap adversarial (swap two players' teams in the roster table); (4) unit-change adversarial (report all yardage in meters); metric: exact-match rate on filled stats + mean absolute deviation, per model; use: gate LLM-generated stat claims before they reach X posts/scripts - any claim the harness shows the model gets wrong at >5% gets routed to deterministic template rendering from nflverse instead of free generation - plus a tool-using variant: the LLM must emit executable pandas queries against the provided pbp dataframe and paste back query results before filling stats (execution-grounded rather than memory-grounded).
gate: ADOPT the harness into the content pipeline IF condition (B) beats (A) by >=10 percentage points of exact-match stat accuracy on the 50-game fixture AND the adversarial unit-change task shows <15% degradation; REJECT the scaffold (keep only the eval harness as a monitor) if it fails either.

title: 1715 Knowledge graph assisted automatic sports news writing
improvement: Build gse/content/recap_pipeline.py in three stages: (1) event ingestion - parse NFL/NBA play-by-play into (period, time, team, event, score) tuples; (2) KEE-style segmentation - replace the fixed 8-point threshold with a sport-specific win-probability-swing detector (segment on |DeltaWP| >= 10 pp or scoring-run extrema); (3) KG enrichment - link entities to GSE's player/team/injury graph and inject verified attributes (season stats, injury status, line movement) into the generation prompt as structured context, every injected fact cited to its source row; generation = template + LLM hybrid, the LLM may only use KG-provided facts for numbers/names, with an entity-linking confidence gate (any linked entity below 0.9 confidence is dropped) - plus: (1) make the KG temporal - snapshot player/team/injury attributes at kickoff, forbid post-game knowledge in enrichment, then run the paper's own ROUGE + human protocol twice (static vs kickoff-snapshot KG) to quantify how much of its reported gain is post-game leakage; (2) a learned segmenter: train a small classifier on analyst-labeled 'news-worthy passage' boundaries using WP swing, scoring-run length, and injury-event indicators.
gate: ADAPT the architecture (event segmentation -> entity linking -> KG-enriched generation), not the paper's artifacts; ADAPT only if the reproducible test shows the factual-error reduction with the WP-swing segmenter on NFL data; REJECT the KG-enrichment step (keep KEE-style segmentation only) if entity-linking precision on NFL text falls below 95%.

title: Estimating the age-conditioned average treatment effects curves: An application for assessing load-management strategies in the NBA
improvement: Build gse-acte-rest: unit = player-game; treatment definitions: W=1 short rest (<=3 days since last game, TNF short week) vs W=0 normal rest, plus W=1 travel >2000 miles vs 0; outcomes: EPA/play, success rate, fantasy points per game, snap-weighted; team-level: offensive/defensive EPA; covariates: player, team, opponent, home/away/neutral, season+week fixed effects, opponent Elo, weather; model: X-learner with honest RF base + S-learner spline baseline, propensity model on age+covariates; simulation sanity gate first (replicate the paper's 3-scenario DGP with NFL-like treatment prevalence); serving: precompute tau-hat(a) curves per position group; at prediction time, adjust player projections by age-specific rest/travel treatment effect when conditions differ from league average; feed tau-hat into the injury-risk/workload overlay - plus upgrade to continuous dose-response: replace W in {0,1} with days-of-rest as continuous dose via a generalized propensity score / DR-learner, estimating age-conditioned dose-response curves tau(a,d) (a graded rest adjustment, e.g. +x% projection bump per rest day, age-specific).
gate: ADOPT the ACTE rest-adjustment into GSE projections only if: (a) on the synthetic DGP, X-learner+RF recovers the true nonlinear tau(a) with MSE at least 30% below the naive difference-in-means estimator; (b) on real NFL data, the 90% bootstrap CI for at least one position group's ACTE excludes zero over a contiguous age band >=3 years AND the direction matches domain sense; (c) cross-learner sign agreement: S/T/X agree on sign in >=70% of age bins with n>=200 games; otherwise reject - fall back to simple age x rest interaction terms.

title: Genie: Generative Interactive Environments
improvement: 'GSE-LAM': apply the LAM recipe to structured NGS tracking sequences (not pixels, to keep compute sane): encoder takes tracking frames x_{1:t} and x_{t+1} -> discrete latent action a-tilde_t (codebook |A| = 32-64, larger than 8 for football's richer action space); decoder reconstructs the next tracking frame from history + a-tilde_t; the learned codebook becomes an UNSUPERVISED PLAY-CONCEPT vocabulary - discovered route concepts, run schemes, blitz packages - usable as the action/token vocabulary for the 1944/1948 sequence models instead of hand-engineered play-type labels; encoder/decoder over (x, y, vx, vy) arrays per player - plus hierarchical LAM: a coarse codebook (|A|=8, run/pass/special-teams-ish) plus a fine codebook (|A|=64) conditioned on the coarse code, mirroring football's natural hierarchy (play family -> specific concept).
gate: ADOPT the LAM-discovered codebook as GSE's play-descriptor vocabulary if interpretability purity >=80% on run/pass/play-action AND the downstream 1948 test is within 5% of hand-labeled descriptors (parity = free vocabulary, no manual labeling); REJECT if codes collapse (utilization <50%) or purity <60%; REJECT pixel-level Genie replication (compute) - the structured-tracking LAM is the portable core.

title: Sizing the bets in a focused portfolio
improvement: Port the constrained multivariate Kelly to Python (scipy Newton / SLSQP with constraint enumeration for N <= 10; SLSQP directly on the log-growth objective for larger N); inputs: engine win probabilities per pick, odds -> payoff multiples, joint outcome model (start with independence + game-level blocks, graduate to bootstrap covariance); constraints: long-only, no leverage, max 25% per pick, P=1% / K=30% permanent-loss constraint for the public bankroll - plus estimate the joint outcome distribution with a Gaussian copula fit on historical pick residuals (per-pick marginals from the engine's calibration curve) instead of assuming independence, and re-solve (accounting for correlated losses - bad weeks hit many picks - shrinks aggregate exposure and cuts tail drawdown vs the independence solution).
gate: ADOPT if walk-forward max drawdown <= 0.25-Kelly's drawdown at ROI within 1 pp of the best baseline; REJECT if the joint-probability estimation step dominates (performance collapses under bootstrap covariance vs independence - then the method is not usable without a better dependence model).

title: SportQA: A Benchmark for Sports Understanding in Large Language Models
improvement: Build a GSE LLM content gate: clone SportQA (public GitHub), extract the American-football L2/L3 subsets + all scenario-style L3 questions (all 6 sports, for generalization signal); build a GSE eval harness: run candidate models (the ones GSE actually uses for content: GPT-series, Gemini, Llama, Nemotron via NVIDIA NIM) at temperature 0, 5-shot SP + 5-shot CoT with the repo's dev exemplars, scoring accuracy by level; write ~200 GSE-specific questions in the L3 multiple-select style targeting what the benchmark lacks (NFL rules edge cases, fantasy scoring implications, pick-rationale QA), reviewed by a domain expert; use the harness as the gate for any LLM swap in the x-poster/kit content pipeline - a model must clear >= the incumbent's SportQA-football accuracy before it drafts public copy - plus a decision-weighted score: sample GSE's real content decisions (which reply drafts got posted, which were held at <9.2) and test whether a model's SportQA L3 score predicts its draft-acceptance rate (point-biserial r > 0.3 on >=300 drafts).
gate: ADAPT if: (a) the SportQA repo is downloadable and the football subsets extract cleanly (>=1,000 L2 + >=200 L3 football questions parse), AND (b) at least one GSE-used model scores within 5 pp of the paper's GPT-4 L3 football numbers, confirming the harness discriminates on 2026 models; reject (the adaptation, not the paper) if the dataset link is dead or football content is <500 questions - then fall back to the companion paper 2406.14877's instrument instead.

title: 1026 Conformalized Selective Regression
improvement: Apply CSR to GSE's prop/DFS point projections: fit two quantile regressors (LightGBM quantile at alpha/2 and 1-alpha/2, alpha=0.10 for 90% intervals) on the existing prop projection feature set; conformalize on a recent calibration window (last 4-6 NFL weeks, ~10-20% of training rows); abstain (don't publish / don't bet) when W_alpha(X) >= lambda, with lambda set to hit a target coverage (e.g. 90%); quantile fits batch-fit weekly, interval width computed per slate at publish time, reject decisions logged with widths for the coverage-error curve - plus weight the economics: replace the paper's unweighted distance with an expected-profit objective - profit = (edge x stake x hit-rate) - (abstention opportunity cost) - choosing lambda to maximize backtested P&L at fixed bankroll; make alpha adaptive per slate (fit on the calibration window to maximize the profit objective); try Mondrian conformalization by position group (QB/RB/WR/TE props) since prop error distributions are strongly position-heterogeneous.
gate: ADOPT CSR if, on the held-out weeks 15-18 test window, CSR's 90%-coverage MAE is >= 5% lower than the conditional-variance reject baseline at the same coverage, AND empirical coverage of the conformal intervals on the calibration window is within +/-3 points of the nominal 90%; reject if the width rule does not beat ensemble-spread rejection or if coverage calibration drifts >5 points (exchangeability failure).

title: DS-Agent: Automated Data Science by Empowering Large Language Models with Case-Based Reasoning
improvement: Build a GSE case bank as the memory substrate for the discovery loop, on top of the 2082 harness: case schema (SQLite): (case_id, hypothesis_text, feature_code, backtest_spec, feedback_log (the 2084 Reflexion reflections), dev_score (2025-holdout DeltaBrier), stage3_score (locked-season), retained_flag, embedding); seed with the 5 hand-verified baseline signals + every future discovery-loop attempt (including failures); development stage (nightly): idea generator retrieves top-k cases by embedding similarity to the new hypothesis; ReviseRank step: an LLM re-ranks cases conditioned on the last night's feedback; planner writes the experiment plan reusing the top case; executor runs; retain if it passes the Stage-2 gate; deployment stage (weekly, cheap): retrieve the current best production-pipeline case and regenerate the weekly model-fit code with minor adaptation on a small/cheap model - plus counter-case retrieval: for each retrieved success case, also retrieve the most similar FAILED case and inject its feedback into the planner prompt, testing whether negative cases prevent repeating known failure modes faster than positive cases guide success.
gate: ADOPT if: CBR arm passes >=6/10 hypotheses within budget vs <=3/10 cold-start; ReviseRank demonstrably demotes at least one misleading case per night on average; deployment-stage regeneration succeeds one-pass >=80% of weeks over 8 weeks with the small model; REJECT if cold-start matches within 1 hypothesis, or retained cases show score decay on re-run (bank poisoning), or ReviseRank rankings are uncorrelated with next-iteration outcomes.

title: SINDy vs Hard Nonlinearities and Hidden Dynamics: a Benchmarking Study
improvement: Discover game-state dynamics equations: build game-state trajectories from nflverse pbp: state = [score_diff, time_remaining, yardline, down, distance, EPA_rolling, timeouts] per game (~60-160 steps); observed output = win probability or points scored; PySINDy with control: inputs = game-context controls (home, rest, spread); library = 2nd-order polynomials + abs terms (|score_diff| for garbage-time nonlinearities) + indicator terms for turnovers/red zone; derivative-coordinate trick: add d(score_diff)/d(play) and d(time)/d(play) as constructed states; hidden-state strategy for 'momentum': posit a latent variable h with assumed linear restoring structure, reconstruct h per game from residual dynamics, fit h-dot with a SINDy library (the Bouc-Wen iterative recipe applied to sports); evaluate on open-loop simulation of 2025 games - plus weak-form SINDy for NFL: replace derivative fitting with the integral/weak formulation applied to the game-state trajectories, testing whether weak-form recovers sparser, more stable equations than STLS.
gate: ADOPT if: hidden-state SINDy achieves BFR >= 70% on the held-out 2025 Weeks 1-8 window AND beats both baselines by >= 10 BFR points AND the recovered equation contains <= 8 nonzero terms; REJECT if: BFR < 50%, or metric-optimal model is structurally nonsensical on human review, or baselines win.

title: An analysis of the NCAA college football playoff team selections using an Elo ratings model
improvement: Build a tuned-Elo baseline on nflverse 2000-2025: all 32 teams init 1500, K-factor tuned (grid 10-60) against log-loss of implied win probability on out-of-sample games, expected-outcome formula with the 400 divisor; add NFL-relevant extensions the paper lacks: home-field offset (~55 Elo points, tuned), margin-of-victory multiplier (scaled by log margin / expected-margin), preseason prior regression toward 1500 (~60-70% carryover tuned); features: game result only, from nflverse schedules - plus a per-season Bayesian Elo with team-specific K drawn from a hierarchical prior (strong teams learn faster; early-season games get lower effective K via time-decay), fit by maximizing out-of-sample log-loss.
